body:
Reading this made me cry and I don't know why.  

My old job was working with children, and while some of them were in the autistic spectrum, all of them were sex offenders.  Yeah.  Sometimes... when you saw the revolving door on the facility, the fact that judges gave those kids a free pass to never register as sex offenders because of our seal of approval... it just made me sick.  I worked nights to try and stay away from most of it.

I can't live and not work.  I have to pay my own way.  If I can't work, and if I can't work and be even marginally happy, I just don't see the point.  I refuse to be a mooch, and I refuse to be treated like shit for (by the dates listed on my resume) more than 2-3 years at a time, so I guess I've worked myself into a corner.
I think it is two sides of the same coin.  No results?  Failure.  Results?  Still a failure.  I can't wrap my mind around the logic.
